_note: Claims this sprint will be judged on, and HOW each is re-derived. Written at
open, not at close — a claim invented at close is a report wearing a receipt's
clothes. `since` takes the sprint-open commit sha once it exists.
derive: file | receipt | contains | ciStep | commitSince | gate | manual
must: true means the sprint does not close without it.
NEEDLE RULE, learned on this file's first run: a `contains` needle must not span
a line wrap. X4 originally used 'strictly FUNGI' and reported MISSING against a
spec that says exactly that — because the source hard-wraps between the two
words. Pick needles short enough to survive an 88-column re-wrap, or the check
reports a false negative and someone re-does finished work.
